canonical_project: NIRA national digital identity infrastructure (HUBIYE/CDS/eAqoonsi; ABIS at Aden Adde)
owner: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) / World Bank Scaled-UP
notes: Government/identity category, not commercial DC. HUBIYE verifier, Certificate Delivery System and eAqoonsi app in Mogadishu (A); World Bank mass-registration pilot launched Aug 18 2025 in Shangani/Boondheer districts (A). ABIS law-enforcement biometric system with a secure facility at Aden Adde International Airport (2,000,000 ten-print + 50,000 latent records, secondary backup server) is a separate B/C lead (Biometric Update/HigherGov mirror of FBI RFI).
